|  | **How to get started** |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | 1. **<u>Make a copy of this sheet</u>** and save it to your personal Google Drive<br>2. Install the Claude for Sheets extension (<u>it may already be installed</u>, in which case, skip to step 3) |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  | a. Go to the [Claude for Sheets extension listing](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/claude_for_sheets/909417792257) |  |  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  | b. Click the <u>blue install button</u> |  |  |  |  |  |
